# COMPAT matrix expectations (measured by the importers, not asserted).

# <source> <metric> <value>
#
# nginx         : the five-config migration corpus (tests/fixtures/migrations/)
# apache        : the equivalent-importer fixture (apache.conf)
# openlitespeed : the perClientConnLimit throttle fragment (ols-throttle.conf)

# `directives` is the number of distinct directives the NGINX reports mention,
# `directives` for apache is the number of directive instances in the fixture and
# `fields` is the number of keys the OLS fragment emits.
#

# this file, docs/compat/COMPAT_*.md and docs/architecture/079-compat-matrix-review.md
# in the same change.
